title: Jim Nantz says he 'learned a lesson' trying to Peanut punch ball from J.J. Watt: Don't do it

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jim Nantz says he 'learned a lesson' trying to Peanut punch ball from J.J. Watt: Don't do it
sources.description: Jim Nantz took J.J. Watt's invitation to demonstrate the Peanut punch while they were broadcasting Sunday's Bills-Raiders game — "and as soon as I did it, I regretted it," he told Pat McAfee.
